_note: All real-valued quantities are exact decimal strings parsed to WAD-18 integers. SI units unless stated. Every constant is a declared surrogate-model assumption, not a validated material or nuclear-data value; see docs/MODEL_CARD.md.

metadata.title: Advancing Nuclear Fusion Through Invariant-Driven Recursive Refinement
metadata.subtitle: Reproducibility capsule for integrated breeding blanket performance
metadata.author: Michael A. Russell
metadata.arithmetic: WAD-18 (integer-exact fixed point, scale 10^18, floor rounding, signed 256-bit results)
metadata.model_class: REDUCED_ORDER_SURROGATE (1-D parametric correlations; not Monte Carlo transport, not CFD)

f_struct.meaning: stiffening-structure volume fraction of breeding zone

f_cool.meaning: coolant flow-area fraction of breeding zone

radial_build.meaning: radial space for breeding zone + multiplier + manifold + shield

lsh_breeder.meaning: fast-flux attenuation length in breeding zone

fw_area.meaning: first-wall area of analysed module slice

eps0.meaning: blanket energy multiplication without multiplier layer

eps_mult.meaning: energy multiplication per unit multiplier gain

cp.meaning: water heat capacity at 15.5 MPa, ~310 C

fs_min_slope.meaning: minimum stiffener fraction per metre of box depth

be_inventory_rate.meaning: tritium retained in multiplier per metre thickness

theta._note: Uncertain model parameters. rel = symmetric relative half-range for UQ corners and one-at-a-time sensitivity.

lambda0.meaning: breeding attenuation length of pure breeder [m]

constraints.name: C01_tbr_min
constraints.meaning: TBR required for fuel self-sufficiency incl. recovery losses and margin

constraints.name: C04_breeder_temp_max
constraints.meaning: breeder/steel compatibility limit applied to peak breeder temperature

constraints.name: C06_shield_attenuation
constraints.meaning: magnet fast-flux attenuation e^-5.5 or better

constraints.name: C08_structure_fraction
constraints.meaning: stiffener fraction / depth-dependent minimum >= 1 (normalised form; revised in 1.0.1)

evaluation_protocol.hypervolume_dp_normalisation: dp axis divided by the reference dp so HV is dimensionless
evaluation_protocol.selection_rule: From the R3 front, among designs that Pareto-dominate the reference and have every normalised constraint slack >= selection_margin, choose maximum TBR; ties -> lower dp; ties -> lexicographically smallest grid index.

acceptance.PO1_reproducible_execution: PASS iff two complete executions produce byte-identical result files (checked by reproduce.py).
acceptance.PO2_constraint_satisfaction: PASS iff the selected candidate has every constraint slack >= 0 under nominal theta.
acceptance.PO3_engineering_improvement: PASS iff TBR(d*) >= TBR(d0) and dp(d*) <= dp(d0) with at least one strict, nominal theta.
acceptance.PO4_contribution_of_R3: STRONG iff HV(R3) > max HV over all primary-baseline seeds; PASS iff HV(R3) > median HV of the primary baseline; otherwise FAIL. Secondary baseline reported, equal unique-evaluation budget.
acceptance.PO5_robustness: PASS iff d* is feasible and dominates d0 at all 64 theta corners; otherwise PARTIAL (with counts) or FAIL if feasible at no corner.
acceptance.PO6_physical_relevance: Cannot be established by this capsule: requires benchmarked transport/thermal-hydraulic models and experimental evidence. Always reported NOT_ESTABLISHED here.
